LESSON: AUDITORY MEMORY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.1: Auditory memory
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Auditory memory, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: What activities do we do when it’s rainy? 2. What activities do we do when it is windy?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recall letter sounds and syllables in and out of class,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Auditory memory together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

• Communication and collaboration: The learner listens attentively to the teacher presenting letter sounds and syllables and

in response articulate the same by chanting collaboratively.

• Self-efficacy: The learner is motivated when reading aloud letter sounds and syllables as the others listen.

• Respect: The learner works amicably with others in class taking positively opinions of others.

• Peace: The learner works with others with care and harmony as they take turns in chanting letter rhymes collaboratively.
